facts.fact: TechAfrica News says 2Africa was declared complete and activated in late 2025 and that Vodacom oversaw multiple South African landings; no landing station is named.

TechAfrica News says 2Africa is built on an open-access principle, with landing station operators providing equitable wholesale access to its capacity (continent-wide statement, applied to its landings including South Africa).

systems.owner: Meta (lead), China Mobile International, Orange, Telecom Egypt, STC center3, WIOCC, MTN GlobalConnect, Vodacom
